declared_at: 2026-10-21T00:34Z (written before any noise-floor unfold was submitted)
authority: director ruling on the MP1-A G3 outcome, 2026-10-20, item 2 (to be recorded in binding addendum 10)
status: DESCRIPTIVE. No gate, no re-gating. It cannot revive MP1-A under the frozen PLAN 2.3 rule; it informs whether MP1-A-full is needed or a training-noise floor should be handled by a different design.

inputs.note: the S1 real-data lateral dumps (merged over all 12 playlists, 1A..1P), unchanged; each task re-verifies the dump sha256

unfold.only_change_from_S1: --estimator-seed (S1 used the default 42); for --construction data it is the only stochastic input (refinement and OmniFold estimator seeds)
unfold.seed_42_products: the S1 products mp1s1_<v>_b-_j-.npz are reported beside the K seeds, never pooled into the scatter estimate

compute.layout: one exclusive node per seed, the 5 variants as concurrent srun steps (32 cpus, 56G each)
compute.deadline: anything not complete by 05:30 PDT 2026-10-21 is cancelled and the study is deferred

readout.f: f = U x with U and xs from mp1_s2.u_matrix on the frozen design (404446eb...), exactly as G3

quantities.T_v: sum over the domain of the per-cell sample variance (ddof=1) of f_v over the K seeds, v in {0, s-, s+}
quantities.N_unpaired: sqrt(T_+ + T_- + 4 T_0): the expected second-difference norm (rms) if each unfold carried independent noise of the measured size
quantities.curv_S1: ||f_+ + f_- - 2 f_0|| for the seed-42 products (the G3 numerator)
quantities.curv_paired_k: ||f_+,k + f_-,k - 2 f_0,k|| for each seed k, the same seed in all three unfolds as in S1
quantities.curv_seedmean: ||mean_k f_+ + mean_k f_- - 2 mean_k f_0||, compared with N_unpaired / sqrt(K)
quantities.span_k: ||f_+,k - f_-,k|| per seed, and the span of the seed means
reported_ratios: curv_seedmean / span_seedmean (descriptive, the G3 form on seed means, NOT a gate)

readout.caveat_declared: with K=5 each T_v carries a chi-square(4) relative uncertainty (about +-70% at 1 sigma on T, +-35% on N); readings within a factor ~2 of 1 are not distinguished
